meta.title: Skipping states
meta.subtitle: The life of one relationship, which is the shape that needs a lane to spare

provenance.note: The state family of this repository's own model, kept as a fixture because it is the shape that showed a channel sized for exactly its demand costing a relationship. Every state is in one column; four transitions skip past the middle to Recorded and all want the channel above it, while another descends across that channel. With no lane to spare the last arrival is left the one lane the descent blocks.
